activity.notes: John Ross's 1818 Baffin Bay expedition recorded that the northern Greenland Inuit encountered by the expedition named Tulloowak when asked for their chief. ATLAS uses a single 1818 attestation point rather than inventing a reign interval. The community is represented as Inughuit (Polar Inuit), the modern identification of the far-north Greenland group encountered by Ross, rather than the broader mod label 'Kalaallit of Western Greenland'.

sources.title: John Ross, A Voyage of Discovery... for Exploring Baffin's Bay (1819)
sources.citation_text: Ross records that, when asked whether they had a chief, the northern Greenlanders answered affirmatively and gave the name Tulloowak.
